crossRefs.note: When he had come, the Jews who had come down from Jerusalem stood around him, bringing against him many and grievous…
having a good conscience. Thus, while you are spoken against as evildoers, they may be disappointed who curse your good…

translations.web: Nor can they prove to you the things of which they now accuse me.
translations.bsb: Nor can they prove to you any of their charges against me.
translations.kjv: Neither can they prove the things whereof they now accuse me.
translations.asv: Neither can they prove to thee the things whereof they now accuse me.
